support.title: Support Center
support.subtitle: Need help? Check our frequently asked questions or get in touch.
support.bugDesc: Found a technical issue? Open an issue on our GitHub repository.
support.contactDesc: For general questions or feedback, send us an email.
support.securityDesc: If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT report it publicly on GitHub. Email us directly so we can address it responsibly.
support.faq1q: Can I recover a message after it's been burned?
support.faq1a: No. Once a message is viewed (burned) or expired, it is permanently deleted from our servers. There are no backups.
support.faq2q: I lost my password. Can you recover it?
support.faq2a: No. NoteBurner uses a zero-knowledge architecture. Your password never leaves your device, so we don't have it and cannot recover it for you.
support.faq3a: Yes. The extension encrypts selected text locally on your machine before sending only the encrypted data to our servers. It is open source and can be audited on GitHub.
support.faq4q: How long can a message last?
support.faq4a: You can set messages to expire anywhere from 1 hour to 7 days. If not viewed by then, they are automatically deleted.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We believe privacy is a fundamental right. That's why NoteBurner is built with a zero-knowledge architecture.
privacy.overviewText: NoteBurner respects your privacy. Our browser extension and web application process your data locally in your browser and only communicate with NoteBurner servers to create encrypted messages. We have no way to decrypt your messages.
privacy.onlyReceive3: Random access token (not linked to you)
privacy.enc1Desc: All encryption happens in your browser using AES-256-GCM before any data leaves your device.
privacy.enc2Desc: Your password never leaves your device. We store only the encrypted ciphertext. We cannot decrypt your messages even if compelled to do so.
privacy.enc3Desc: All data is transmitted over HTTPS (TLS 1.3) with HSTS enabled.
privacy.retentionDesc: Your data is ephemeral by design. We strictly enforce deletion policies:
privacy.retentionItem1: Automatic Deletion: Messages are deleted immediately after the first successful decryption (for "Burn on read" messages).
privacy.retentionItem2: Expiration: All messages have a hard expiration time (default 24 hours, max 7 days).
privacy.retentionItem3: Permanent Removal: When a message is deleted, it is permanently purged from our database. No backups are retained.
privacy.questionsDesc: If you have any questions about our privacy practices, please contact us.
